name: Bob Pay Plugin
author: Bob Group

sections.description:
Bob Pay: Secure, Simple, and Cost-Effective Online Payments

Bob Pay, the payment gateway from Bob Group, offers South African merchants a secure, cost-effective way to accept online payments. With no startup or payout fees, only a minimal transaction fee applies. Key features include PCI DSS compliance, SSL encryption, redundancy for high availability, scalability for high transaction volumes, and proactive monitoring. Bob Pay is an ideal solution for ecommerce businesses, offering stability, security, and custom API integrations.

  • State-of-the-art encryption and protocols safeguard every transaction.
  • Meets strict global standards to ensure your payments are secure.
  • Protects data transmission with secure, encrypted connections.
  • Built-in redundancy and failover ensure minimal downtime.
  • Handles high transaction volumes with ease, growing with your business.

Supported banks currently include: FNB, Nedbank, Absa, Standard Bank, Capitec, Investec, Discovery Bank, TymeBank and Bank Zero.

Transaction fees:

Credit and debit cards———————2.70%
American Express—————————2.70%
Foreign cards———————————3.10%
Scan to Pay————————————2.70%
Instant and manual EFT——————-1.50%
Capitec Pay————————————1.50%
PayShap—————————————-1.50%
Nedbank Direct EFT (coming soon)—-1.50%
Absa Pay (coming soon)——————-1.50%

Receive discounted pricing if you process more than R500,000 per month, or if you’re a Bob Go merchant*.
* Must have a paid Bob Go subscription.
sections.installation:
1. Register your Bob Pay account and complete the merchant onboarding process to receive online payments.
  2. Wait for approval before proceeding to the next steps.
  3. Once approved, download the Bob Pay plugin.
  4. Install and activate the plugin through your WordPress dashboard.
  5. Go to WooCommerce > Settings > Payments in your WordPress dashboard.
  6. Enable the Bob Pay payment methods you want to offer your customers at checkout and fill in the required details as prompted.
  7. Ensure that the “Enable Bob Pay” option is checked.
  8. Make sure “Enable development mode” is unchecked.
  9. Your setup is now complete, and you’re ready to start receiving payments with Bob Pay.
